svg.text: FinAware — System Architecture with ML Financial Risk Assessment
Existing system unchanged · new components (green) follow the supplied UML class, use-case, activity and sequence diagrams
The browser never calls the ML or data services directly
Existing: Sidebar, MetricCard, RiskBadge (legacy demo badge), forms, charts, AI recs card
middleware.ts — auth guard, FICA (+2 protected routes)
Session check on every route (401 if absent)
Only component of the ML feature
Users 1—1 Financial_Profile 1—* Risk_Assessment 1—* Risk_Driver / Recommendation (UUID keys)
Migration creates 4 tables + indexes only — no ALTER / DROP; existing data untouched
Each assessment stores model, target & rules versions, input snapshot, indicators and warnings (traceability)
train.py → 4 models, 5-fold CV, test metrics, ablation
Docker Compose — existing 9 containers + SQLite volume
Helm dev/stag/prod — Deployments, Services, Ingress, HPA
ml-service image: multi-stage, trains at build, non-root
+ npm test · Python job: audit, train, pytest
Existing Helm resources render byte-identical; ConfigMap only gains 5 keys. Ingress still exposes only the web app.
